title: American public opinion on AI
description: Repeated poll questions on how the US public feels about AI: Pew's and Gallup's, asked about once a year, and the monthly tracker Epoch AI began with Ipsos in October 2026.

sources.name: Epoch AI — Polling on AI usage

notes: The Pew and Gallup figures are hand-entered from published releases — neither offers a machine-readable feed — with every figure's citation recorded alongside it in manual/us-ai-opinion.csv. The Epoch AI line is read from the CSV Epoch publishes for each wave of its tracker: about 2,000 US adults from Ipsos' KnowledgePanel, fielded over a few days each month since October 2026, with each point at the middle of the fieldwork. Epoch asks Pew's question word for word but adds a 'Not sure' answer, which about one respondent in five took in the first wave, where Pew offers only more excited, more concerned and equally both. That is why the Epoch line runs several points below Pew's, and why the two are never joined up. The lines come from different surveys with different question wording and sampling, so read the movement within a line and not the gaps between them.
